text:
Andi (AE): Heads-up — FinCo wants concrete logging/audit evidence for the upcoming POC. They specifically asked for: admin activity (console + API), API key rotation entries, retention proof (1 year), and details on how to forward to their SIEM. Can we assemble a small evidence bundle + attestation? timeline = 48h?

Dave (SRE/SE): @Andi we can. Output we can produce: a) sample audit bundle (JSON + CSV) b) forwarding configs for Splunk/Datadog/syslog TLS c) retention docs + S3 object-lock/manifest d) redaction policy + sample redacted lines. Need to confirm: this is for Hosted, right? That affects retention options.

Andi (AE): Confirmed — Hosted (self-serve/test tenant). They still require 1 year retention and a signed attestation that admin actions are logged.

Ben (Security): Quick notes: Hosted default audit retention = 90 days. Options to meet 1yr: 1) Real-time forward to customer SIEM (Splunk HEC/HTTPS recommended) 2) Export bundles to customer-owned S3 with object-lock + KMS 3) Recommend Dedicated/Private for native long-term retention. We can provide a SHA256 manifest for bundles and a signed attestation PDF. Also need to ensure PII redaction rules are applied before handing over.

Priya (Customer Sec): From their checklist: must include console UI events (policy changes, role grants), API key rotation logs, admin impersonation, and emergency access events. Preferred ingest: Splunk HEC. They also asked about proof that logs are immutable after export (WORM).

Dave (SRE/SE): We support Splunk HEC, syslog/tcp+tls, Kafka, and HTTP push. Example Splunk HEC forwarder snippet below (quick):

```
# Splunk HEC example
curl -k https://splunk.example.com:8088/services/collector -H 'Authorization: Splunk <HEC_TOKEN>' \
  -d '{"event": {"ts":"2026-02-01T12:34:56Z","user":"admin@example.com","action":"role.grant","resource":"project-xyz"}}'
```

Ben (Security): Example redacted audit line (JSON):

```
{"ts":"2026-02-01T12:34:56Z","actor":"REDACTED_USER","actor_id":"user-******","action":"api_key.rotate","target":"service-account-123","ip":"198.51.100.23","result":"success"}
```

Ben (Security): For immutability proof we can: 1) export logs to customer S3 with object-lock in compliance mode 2) provide manifest with SHA256 hashes for each bundle + signed assertion (security@redwood.com). That should satisfy vendor risk team.

LogBot: export job started for thread 1796000000 — preparing audit bundle (phase: collect) ETA ~2h :gear:

Andi (AE): Awesome. Can we commit to providing: sample bundle + signed attestation + forwarding config within 48h? I'll tell FinCo to pause the SOC questionnaire deadline by 72h.

Dave (SRE/SE): Yes. I'll coordinate infra and get the bundle + manifest ready in 24–36h. Attestation PDF will come from Ben. Forwarding config + quick runbook for Splunk HEC will be included.

Priya (Customer Sec): Once we have the bundle I will validate that admin actions are present and that API key rotation events are clear. Also will check that all user-identifying fields are redacted per policy.

Andi (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and request a short call if they want live walkthrough.

Dave (SRE/SE): cc @Ben — will DM you the bundle link when ready.

Ben (Security): Will prepare the attestation and pointer to the redaction policy.

LogBot: export bundle ready (1796000000/bundle-2026-02-01.zip) — 2 files: audit.jsonl (1.2MB), manifest.sha256 — link: https://internal.artifacts/redwood/1796000000/bundle-2026-02-01.zip

Andi (AE): Got it. Thanks all — looping customer in now.
